positiveComments:
1. Skin Type
I have combination dehydrated skin. While my face is generally oily all over, during seasonal changes, my cheeks become dry. My cheeks get rough, and my skin deteriorates as if my immune system is weakening. Even dermatologists say it's just due to seasonal changes and stress, so I've accepted that I can't fix it and am destined to use only gentle skincare products.

2. Overall Review
Oh my goodness, it's absolutely amazing! I'm about to praise it so much that you might wonder if this is a sponsored post from Mediheal. But I genuinely love this product. I'll definitely repurchase it. For those of you with combination dehydrated and super sensitive skin who constantly check ingredients on Hwahae, why not give this a try?

3. Texture
What's the key for combination dehydrated skin? It's a product that feels refreshing when applied but also provides adequate hydration. We can't use heavy creams due to our naturally oily skin, but we still need moisture. This product has a clever formula that perfectly understands the needs of combination skin. It's moderately hydrating and light, but not too light, so it feels sufficiently moisturizing. However, being a toner pad, it might not be enough for those with dry skin.

4. The Pads are Excellent
First off, they're huge ­ big enough to cover both my cheeks at once, and I have a pretty large face! I think most people will find them generously sized. I buy pads because full­face sheet masks are too oily and time­consuming for me. For pads, it's important that they adhere well to the face and are large enough to cover without leaving awkward spaces. These pads meet all those conditions perfectly! However, I wouldn't recommend these for exfoliation or dead skin cell removal. The pads are very thin, which makes them stick well to the face, but they can roll up on their own, which can be a bit inconvenient. Also, the embossing isn't very pronounced, so you won't feel like you're scrubbing your face clean. But these aspects aren't major drawbacks since this product is primarily for nourishment and elasticity care. The pads are soaked with plenty of essence ­ enough to use on your face and then wipe other areas too. When you pick up a pad, it won't drip, but if you squeeze it, you'll get a small puddle in your hand.

5. Definite Results!
This was the most surprising part. I usually think two weeks isn't enough to see results, but with this product, I felt the difference from day one. On the first day, I had worn a mask for over 12 hours, and my sensitive skin was stressed ­ the area around my mouth was burning as if something was about to break out, and my cheeks were cracked. I applied this product, and despite my skin being in such a sensitive state, there was no pain or tightness. And the effects were far from minimal. Some of you might relate to this ­ there are days when your skin just feels different after good skincare. It feels firm, and you know any foundation will look good that day. That's how my skin felt after using this pad. I just used it for a 5­10 minute pack after washing my face, followed by my usual skincare routine, and I was amazed at how calmed and improved my skin looked. It's so good that it really does sound like I'm writing a sponsored post, but I'm just sharing my incredible experience. Of course, results may vary, but if you have similar skin to mine, I highly recommend trying this product.

There's honestly nothing negative to say. I'm just overwhelmed by how this product seems tailor­made for me from start to finish...

The lid has a clip, making it much more hygienic to take out and use the pads.
negativeComments:
Skin feels moisturized and refreshed right after application. The hydration lasts until the next morning, keeping the skin feeling supple.

Blemishes... I don't usually have sensitive skin and tend to use various products, but after using this for two days, my cheeks became red and I developed small bumps. This has never happened before, so I'm quite surprised. I checked the ingredients on Hwahae and nothing seems problematic, so I'm not sure why this is happening. Since this is the only new product I've used recently, I'm going to take a break and try it again later. I bought two during a sale, so I hope it works out. I'll update my review if there's anything else to report after observing my skin's condition.

reviews.headline: Refreshing
reviews.comment: I use this everyday and the product makes my face feel refreshed and clean.

reviews.headline: Best decision I made to purchase
reviews.comment: Of all the toner pads I've tried, this is non-abrasive, gentle on skin and works well for me.

reviews.headline: Great pads….But
reviews.comment: I put these pads in the fridge and use them after cleansing. The cold feels great against my skin and I can do my whole face and neck. BUT you will need pliers to open them!

reviews.headline: Not sure it's doing anything
reviews.comment: These pads are easy to use and I love the packaging with the little tweezers to get the pads out. They do seem to moisturize in the short term but haven't noticed any change in my skin. I guess nothing is magic.

reviews.headline: I'm allergic but my sister isn't
reviews.comment: Unfortunately, my skin barrier has experienced acute damage. I have an acute allergic reaction to a specific ingredient, which has left my nerve endings completely exposed and hypersensitive. I was not rough with these extremely thin pads. I have sensitive skin naturally so this isn't for me. I did let my sister use it and she not only rubbed it all over her face like I had but she put it all m over her neck, chest and arms. she had no reaction to it.
